question: Which is the oldest oil producing state of India?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Assam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Assam__ is the oldest oil (petroleum) producing state of India.

 __
 
• India's oldest oil refinery Digboi is located in Assam.
 
• Assam, Gujarat and Rajasthan, together account for more than 96% of oil from onshore fields.
 
• Assam is the** oldest oil-producing state **in India and has major** oil** fields in India located.
 
• India's first oil well was dug in 1866.
 
• The first commercial discovery of crude oil in India was made in 1889 at Digboi.
 
• The first refinery was started in Digboi in 1901.
 
• Digboi is the oldest oil well still in use.
 
• Other oil refineries in Assam are:
 
 
• Numaligarh Refinery.
 
• Bongaigaon Refinery.
 
• Guwahati Refinery.
